name: quartic_sigma01
title: Quartic Model Data (sigma = 0.1)
description: Data for the two-dimensional quartic toy model of Au, Graham and Thiery (2020), in which a single observation y is modelled as Normal(F(theta), sigma) with F(theta) = theta_1^2 + theta_0^2 (theta_0^2 - 1/2). The data specify the observation y = 1 (as in the paper) and the known noise scale sigma = 0.1, which gives a posterior clearly concentrated around the curved manifold F(theta) = y, moderately challenging for standard samplers.
